player_intent: Mark 23 idle keeps the accepted forward, square-shouldered firing shape with both hands closer to the chest. An accepted shot extends the same shape, holds for the existing 1.2 seconds, then returns smoothly to compressed idle.
acceptance_rule: Standing and crouched canonical Mark 23 use distinct native compressed-idle and recovery-reference clips. Idle hands are centered and at least 5 cm closer to the chest than ready; physical hand contacts remain within 1 cm through entry and return; no extra fire OneShot or recovery timer is introduced. At fixed 60 Hz, ready-to-move, moving-recovery-to-stop and rapid-reversal firing boundaries must remain within 3.5 cm and 6 degrees per frame, with both contacts within 1 cm. Ordinary relaxed locomotion is diagnostic only. Opted-in local muzzle light and smoke follow the presented muzzle after pose evaluation; tracer endpoints and accepted shot data remain unchanged. All required focused checks and rendered review must pass before claiming visual completion.

Reload, mobility, stance changes, relaxed movement and other profiles bypass the fence.

failure_lessons: Standing and crouched ready slots also feed moving and action overlays. A stationary-only authored pose requires explicit saved nonstationary sources at those existing graph nodes; a driver stationary guard alone is insufficient.
A Dictionary can retain a freed pooled Node after scene exit: validate its raw Variant with is_instance_valid before an as Node cast.
Expiry tests must use the render updater's monotonic timestamp explicitly; do not mix SceneTree simulation timers with Time.get_ticks_usec deadlines.
Opted-out profiles create no emitter-follow entries or recurring render callback; only accepted-shot profile lookup/branch bookkeeping remains. Never claim literally zero CPU cost.

Logical animation state changes before AnimationNodeTransition finishes its crossfade. Read its actual current/previous contribution, accounting for the post-evaluation fade decrement; do not toggle baked-correction suppression from movement input alone.

REJECTED and removed: adding crouch-start/stop torso/limb overlay nodes could not remove the full-body cosmetic clip's pelvis-height restart. Final routing skips only those two cosmetic actions for opted-in Mark23 readiness/recovery, retaining continuous crouch base clips and clocks.

The ready base handoff fence finishes the existing same-stance fade before reversing; it adds no queue or timer, never changes movement authority, and never delays reload, posture changes or other actions. Its 0.24-second presentation blend is unrelated to the unchanged 1.2-second fire latch.
